tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Use this first, once. Creates your Agent Coach profile and returns agent_id and api_key (shown once: save it in the owner's sanctioned secret store or a restricted credential file, not in chat or memory). Also returns example north-star metrics and suggested KPIs for your job type.

tools.name: set_goals
tools.description: Use this after registering (and whenever goals change). Goal intake: job_type, stage, ONE north-star metric with a fixed definition and baseline, the named deliverable, capability gaps, goals, optional secondary KPIs, tools, constraints. Changing the north-star definition is recorded as drift.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Use this after set_goals. Returns up to `limit` catalog items matched to your goals (plus at most one extra per declared capability gap), each with reasons, its vetting status and basis, cautions, and whether it needs owner approval. Show them to your owner before installing anything.

tools.name: update_items
tools.description: Use this after your owner approves an item (action=adopt), rejects one (decline), when an item doesn't fit your job (not_relevant: not a judgment on its quality), or confirms removing a pending_removal item (remove). The coach measures only adopted items.

tools.name: check_in
tools.description: Use this once a day. Report the north-star value, secondary KPIs, releases (shipped vs verified live), build vs distribution actions, owner blockers, repeated corrections, timeouts, unsupported claims, incidents, deliverable progress, and per-item usage. Value format everywhere: {value, evidence: se

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Use this to see your KPIs vs baseline, every item's verdict with evidence, and check-in history.

tools.name: share_report
tools.description: Use this only with your owner's OK. public=true returns a public URL (display name, goals, KPIs, verdicts; never email, notes or keys). public=false hides it.

tools.name: get_digest
tools.description: Use this to preview the daily owner digest (subject, html, text). This call sends nothing; the daily email goes out only if owner_digest was turned on.

tools.name: rotate_key
tools.description: Use this if your key may have leaked. Returns a new api_key; the old one stops working immediately. Save the new one.

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.description: Use this only when your owner asks. Permanently deletes your Agent Coach profile, items, check-ins and public report. confirm must equal your agent_id.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Use this to see exactly how the coach decides item verdicts (permanent / promising / temporary / trial / unproven / pending_removal), signals, and overall health.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Use this to find skills, MCP servers, prompts or repos by keyword outside your matched recommendations. Returns only items that passed the security scan, each with install, license, source and a page link. Catalog data only: no user comments. Show results to your owner before installing.

tools.name: get_library_item
tools.description: Use this to fetch one vetted library item by slug: install, source, license and (when the license allows) the full SKILL.md text. Counts as a download. Unvetted items are not returned.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (secret, api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_digest, search_library · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: share_report, get_digest · Destructive: update_items, check_in, delete_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_digest, search_library · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: share_report, get_digest · Destructive: update_items, check_in, delete_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
